hedging_delta.evidence: Prior called results 'about as we expected'; current admits results 'disappointing and below our expectations' with wider, larger-than-normal guidance range signaling more uncertainty.

guidance_direction.evidence: Prior guided Dec quarter down 15-20% sequential (~$1.8-1.9B); current guides March quarter to $1.225-1.425B, an even steeper sequential decline of ~19-31%, continuing the cut trajectory.

quant_claim_escalation.evidence: Lead times target 'less than 8 weeks by end of 2023' in prior call vs actual 'roughly eight weeks' achieved but bookings/visibility worse, and capex cut again from $300-325M to $300-310M.

new_topic_rate.evidence: New topics: discontinuation of PSP program, CHIPS Act $162M DoC grant preliminary MOU, factory shutdown weeks, and broad-based pay cuts (10%/20%) not mentioned prior.

tone_delta.evidence: Prior touted 'record' operating income/EPS/cash return repeatedly; current explicitly calls results 'disappointing' with margins 'down from our recent strong performance.'

demand_language_delta.evidence: Prior said business 'slowed down as expected'; current says business 'was weaker than we expected' with destocking 'at multiple levels' and risk of 'overcorrection.'
